## What is this about?

<!-- generated by aider + aider-skills + skill create-blog-entry-what-is-this-about -->

The skill-openapi-bridge repository provides a command‑line utility that creates OpenAPI 3.1 specifications from agentskills.io skill directories and serves the resulting spec through a local HTTP server. It can fetch a skill from a GitHub repository at a specific commit or branch, embed all supporting files such as scripts, references, and assets, and output a self‑contained JSON spec. The generated spec exposes 25 REST routes that give progressive disclosure access to the skill’s content, enabling agents to retrieve files, metadata, and validation results without external services. Typical use cases include local development, testing, and debugging of agentskills integrations where network isolation or offline operation is required. Developers and AI agents that need reliable, on‑premise access to skill resources benefit from this bridge, and they can start by installing the package and running the skill-openapi-bridge serve command.
